description: This file defines a Spring Data MongoDB repository interface for the ProcessingJob entity, providing CRUD operations and custom query methods for accessing processing job records based on different attributes such as document ID, document version ID, type, and status.

classes.name: ProcessingJobRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for ProcessingJob entities, extending MongoRepository to include custom query methods.

methods.name: findByDocumentId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProcessingJob instances associated with a given document ID.

methods.name: findByDocumentVersionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProcessingJob instances associated with a specific document version ID.

methods.name: findByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProcessingJob instances filtered by their processing type (e.g., OCR, extraction).

methods.name: findByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProcessingJob instances based on their current status (e.g., QUEUED, RUNNING).
